rules: These are historical award records = funded-buyer evidence. NEVER render or write urgency ("closing soon", "deadline") from this data.
Scanned companies are anonymized exactly as the asset file specifies; award recipients and amounts are public record and cited as-is.

label: From real scans - public records surfaced by Opportunity Scanner

creative-economy.name: Arts / Creative Economy / Live Events
creative-economy.narrative: Federal money funds live programming through at least three distinct routes - direct event contractors, cultural institutions, and workforce programs - each implying a different partner/sell motion.

findings.recipient: John F. Kennedy Center for the Performing Arts
findings.implication: Cultural institutions can be funded buyers or channel partners, not only grant makers.
Direct event contractors create a distinct public-sector sell and partner motion.
Local live-performance work creates a contractor route beyond federal arts agencies.
Creative workforce programs can support a workforce-development partnership motion.

education-workforce.name: Education / Workforce / Training
education-workforce.anonymized_company: an arts-educator staffing platform born out of California Prop 28
education-workforce.narrative: Educator-workforce money flows to staffing intermediaries, not only districts - a services company can enter as a recipient partner, not just a district vendor. Prop 28 (California) is a live state-level driver for arts-educator demand.

findings.evidence: K-12 hiring, teacher staffing, and educator workforce work
findings.implication: Staffing intermediaries can receive educator-workforce funding outside a direct district sale.
Teaching-artist staffing can enter through recipient partnerships as well as district procurement.

healthcare-dme.name: Healthcare / DME / Medical Supply
healthcare-dme.anonymized_company: a compression-garment and recovery products brand
healthcare-dme.narrative: DME demand shows up in three tiers - reimbursement infrastructure (nine figures), VA clinical purchasing (eight figures), and direct agency supply buys (five-six figures). The surprising buyer (NASA) is the shareable hook.

findings.implication: Reimbursement infrastructure can create an enterprise partner route around DME purchasing.

findings.evidence: award adjacent to prosthetics and orthotics purchasing
findings.implication: A VA prosthetics-clinic design-build award proves facility investment around the care pathway; it does not prove an open medical-supply purchase.
Direct medical-supply demand can appear in agencies a seller would not normally target.
